observations: body L1-L7: the degrees, minutes and seconds of the values stand in columns, the figures of each column aligned on the right; the list continues that of p. 218.
body L3: the year 1 of Yazdegerd begins on 16 June 632, the year 220 on 23 April 851 (L4).
body L8-L10: the two Persian observations are those of p. 209, note 2; by Caussin (p. 216) the later, about 630, put the apogee in 20° of Gemini, i. e. 80°.
body L9-L10, L26, L28: the dashes of «ash–Shāh», «Sūrya–siddhānta», «190–199» and «al–Battānī» are long dashes (5.3 to 5.5 pt).

body L11, L17, L23: in the heads the dashes after «d)», «e)» and «f)» measure 10.1 to 10.3 pt and are transcribed as dashes; that of «25–26» is the thin long dash of «29–37» on p. 214 (4.3 pt), that of «2-16» a short hyphen (3.4 pt).

body L14-L16: 61p 48′ 2″ = 222482″, whose square is 49 498 240 324; 1p 2′ 22″ 1/2 = 3742″,5, whose square is 14 006 306,25; the sum 49 512 246 630,25 has the root 222 513″,475 = 61p 48′ 33″,47. In L15 «(3472″,5)²» is printed for (3742″,5)², whose square follows.

body L29: the formula is right: with the sines and cosines to the radius R = 60p, the equation q of the centre satisfies tan q = e sin m : (60p + e cos m), so that sin q = R e sin m : √[(e sin m)² + (e cos m + 60p R)²] with the factors R as printed.
body (figure): the figure is redrawn from the print: the circle ABC about E and the two epicycles about A and B, the lines measured on the scan, the diameter NT in dashes, each dash where it printed.
notes_left L1-L3: note 5 of p. 218 goes on here: 82° 39′ less the precession of 3° 9′ 1″ in 214 Arabic years is 79° 29′ 59″, the 79° 30′ of the Tabula Probata.
notes_left L3, notes_right L1: the dash before «Perperam» measures 8.2 pt; the dashes of «al-Mas‘ūdī» and «at-Tanbīh» (3.0 and 3.5 pt) are hyphens.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
